verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test mode, such as test keys, mock responses, or isolated non-production environments, is a fair capability to ask of an AI gateway, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such feature. API keys working in local development and CI, and per-key budgets, are adjacent controls rather than a sandbox that isolates tests from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
